messages:
elin (AE): FYI exec escalation from OrbisCare. CTO says procurement won't sign off unless we support: BYO KMS, dedicated pool with 99.95% uptime SLA for the pilot, and a short pricing runbook for exec review. Asking for a go/no-go within 24h. Can engineering + security confirm? cc @sanjay

raj (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: do they require Private (full control-plane in their VPC) or is Dedicated (our managed but isolated GPUs) acceptable if we can provide KMS binding? Also need expected concurrency and token counts to size GPU pool.

elin (AE): They prefer Private but said Dedicated is fine if keys never leave their control and we can provide a signed key-attestation. Workload: 30k requests/day, spiky to 120 rps, prompts ~90 tokens, responses ~110. Model: redwood-2-medium or compatible. Pilot window: 2 weeks.

maria (Security): BYO KMS + attestations are acceptable. We'll require: (1) KMS usage policy doc, (2) copy of client SOC2/ISO if they're hosting, and (3) signed key handling appendix. I can draft answers for their security questionnaire today. Also need a short KMS key rotation playbook for legal.

leo (Eng-Infra): Technical note: We can bind to customer KMS in Dedicated via cross-account role + restricted kms:GenerateDataKey but for Private control plane we need the customer's gateway + cert. For 120 rps spikes, recommend 3 x A100 equiv to hit p95 latency <500ms without heavy caching. If they accept caching and batching, 2 GPUs could work but margin is tight.

raj (SE): Perf tradeoffs: quantized model + KV prefix caching reduces request tail; recommend enabling prefix cache for repeated prompts and a warmup synthetic workload before demo. I'll prepare a perf table with p50/p95 estimates for 2 vs 3 GPUs.

viv (Finance): Pricing stub: Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) pilot price = $25k/month committed, 3 GPUs = $35k/month. For a 2-week pilot we'll pro-rate and can offer 60% off first month as POC concession. One-time integration fee for BYO KMS/legal/deploy: $6k. We should decide invoice terms (prepay vs net30) — prefer prepay for pilots.

ops-bot: Created infra ticket ORB-2047 assigned to leo (Eng-Infra).

leo (Eng-Infra): ORB-2047: provisioning-orbis-pilot — ETA staging pool 36-48h, production-like 72h. Need their key ARN + cross-account role details and CIDR for peering.

maria (Security): I'll schedule a 30m tech-only call with Orbis security to walk KMS attestation + key rotation. Proposed: tomorrow 9am PT. Can everyone confirm availability?

elin (AE): I'll ask Orbis to confirm 9am PT and to share key ARN + security questionnaire PDF.

sanjay (Head of Sales): Need a 1-page exec summary ASAP for our CEO + their CTO: feasibility (yes/no), delta risk items, ETA, and price snapshot. Raj/Leo/Viv/Maria — can you assemble by EOD? I'll escalate internally once I have that. :up: :thumbsup:

raj (SE): I'll produce the single-page slide with perf numbers and a fallback plan (if we miss 99.95% SLA during pilot, fallback to dedicated route with switched routing policy).

leo (Eng-Infra): I'll include provisioning timeline and exact infra prerequisites. Also will flag network peering tickets that may add latency.

maria (Security): I'll attach the questionnaire answers summary + list of contract clauses we need for key non-access.

elin (AE): Draft note to Orbis CTO (edit before send): "We can support BYO KMS and offer dedicated/private deployment for your pilot. Engineering estimates staging in 36-48h once we receive KMS ARN and peering CIDR. Finance will provide a short pilot quote and integration fee. Proposed next step: confirm 9am PT for the KMS attestation call and share the security questionnaire. Will follow up with a 1-page exec summary."

viv (Finance): One more: if they require SLA 99.95% backed by credits, legal will need to sign off on the credit language. I'll draft provisional terms but need a legal review. Net effect on price: bigger SLA guarantees pushes to 3 GPUs to be safe.

sanjay (Head of Sales): Good. If we can get staging up and the exec slide by EOD, I'll join the customer call and present. Target: staging endpoint + slide in 18 hours.

raj (SE): Action list posted: 1) leo: create staging pool + share endpoint (ORB-2047), 2) maria: questionnaire + call, 3) viv: pilot quote + SLA terms, 4) raj: perf slide. I'll post the perf table in this thread when ready.

ops-bot: ORB-2047 updated: staging created (endpoint shared to PMs), assigned to leo, ETA prod parity 72h.

leo (Eng-Infra): Shared staging endpoint privately. Waiting on key ARN and peering info to finalize bind.

elin (AE): Thanks team. I'll push Orbis for ARN and confirm 9am PT. Sending exec note after slide is in.

sanjay (Head of Sales): Keep me posted. If anything looks risky for the timeline, flag immediately and I'll escalate to leadership. :telephone_receiver:
